# Was the Staples Canada print website breach a hack?

**Confirmed.** Yes, by Staples' own account: an unknown party got into staplesprint.ca without permission between Nov 1 and Nov 5 and had access to customer information. Who did it is not known.

Incident: Staples Canada print website breach, Nov 2026. Also reported as the staplesprint.ca breach and the Staples Print hack. First published Nov 21, 2026; last updated Nov 21, 2026, 12:11 AM ET.

> **Not verified: initial investigation only.** Nothing on this page is absolutely confirmed. It is an early look based only on publicly available sources, and it should not be treated as verified fact. Even items labeled "Confirmed" only mean a public source reports them. Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Staples, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.

This is the current answer, not a final verdict.

## The latest

Nov 21, 2026, 12:11 AM ET: **Staples Canada says an unknown party got into its print website between Nov 1 and 5 and reached customer details.** First draft. 5 sources (0 Tier 1), 11 claims (4 Confirmed, 3 Reported, 1 Unverified, 3 Not established), 6 questions. The company notice is not on a public Staples page; three independent outlets report it. No attacker, method or count. The separate claim against Staples, Inc. is kept apart and labelled Unverified. Privacy check done: no names of private people, no handles, no contact details.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Local. One print-ordering website in Canada. Staples has not said how many customers were affected.
- Who is affected: Customers of staplesprint.ca whom Staples emailed. Their names, emails, addresses, order summaries and encrypted passwords were involved. Staples says no financial information was.

### Known so far

- An unknown party got into staplesprint.ca without permission and reached customer information.
- The access happened between Nov 1 and Nov 5, 2026.
- Names, emails, shipping and billing addresses, order summaries and encrypted passwords were involved.
- Staples says no financial information was exposed.

### Not known yet

- How many customers were affected.
- Who was behind it.
- How they got in.
- Whether it has any link to the separate claim against Staples, Inc.
